column1: SPEC — Cash Routing, Deposits & Sweeps (Simplified Banks)
Policy: One Operating checking per entity for collections & spend. Savings/Investments for reserves only. Revenue type = accounting, not bank.
Optional: Dr 1090 Undeposited on payment batch → Cr 1090 / Dr 1000 when bank deposit clears.
• Operating 1000 → Entity Savings 1040: policy % or manual (sub working capital).
• Group profits → TVC 1010 Bank for Investments: Finance-approved (e.g. 90% model).
• Each sweep = JE between cash GLs + audit log. Never auto-spend from 1010/1040 without policy.
Free cash ≈ Operating 1000 − due AP − payroll due − 2250 commission liability − approved pending sweeps.
Savings 1040 and Investments 1010 are NOT free ops cash by default.
Always provision BA-{CODE}-OP (1000) + BA-{CODE}-SV (1040). No revenue-type banks. Report revenue by SKU/CoA 4xxx.
Feed Enabled on Operating + Savings (+ parent Investments). Cards as separate Type=Credit Card rows in MD - Bank Accounts.
Cursor: Routing table is data-driven; default deposit_gl=1000 for all invoice.paid events.
